text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Canary alert: rdx-v14 exhibiting elevated tail latency on streaming /v1/streams (us-west-2). p95 and p99 thresholds breached. Auto-page sent to oncall.

oncall-jon: I'm on it. p95 ~1.1s (norm ~140ms), p99 ~2.9s. Error-rate for extended streams up ~9%. Spinning up traces and top-talkers.

runtime-maria: grabbing stack traces and KV cache metrics. Early signal: much higher cache churn for encoder context keys after v14 tokenizer tweak.

infra-akash: host-level view: encoder pods in canary node pool showing CPU stalls and increased scheduling latency; GPU utilization unchanged. Looks like more small-batch episodes.

eng-leo: tagging runtime and rollout teams. Suggest immediate canary abort: set canary weight to 0 and route new stream sessions to rdx-stable. Can we do graceful drain?

oncall-jon: executing abort now: `rdctl rollout abort --service streams --variant rdx-v14 --graceful=true` -> setting canary weight 0%.

incident-bot: Command run by oncall-jon: `rdctl route update /v1/streams --variant rdx-v14=0`

runtime-maria: quick log snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T11:02:43Z] start_stream id=zz9 token_len=2048 model=rdx-v14
[2026-03-15T11:02:44Z] kv.lookup miss key=enc-ctx-47f
[2026-03-15T11:02:45Z] scheduler.delay=720ms worker.pick=blocked
```

infra-akash: queue depth for the multiplexer doubled leading to head-of-line for some streams. Looks like v14 emits shorter token windows causing more frequent flushes.

pm-amy: any customer-facing impact? Support, please enumerate affected tenants and severity.

support-bot: Created ticket INC-2026-411. Initial affected count: 4 paid orgs with long-lived streaming sessions. Severity S2. Will open private status updates.

eng-leo: monitor for degradation rollback completion and ensure no functional regressions for function-calls/tool-calls during the shift. Also verify fallback model mapping for hybrid routes.

oncall-jon: routing change completed at 3959998025. Telemetry shows p99 falling from 2.9s -> 210ms within ~25s. p95 returning to ~150ms.

runtime-maria: KV hit-rate recovering; performing a targeted cache-warm for popular encoder contexts in canary pool to capture logs for repro.

infra-akash: confirmed worker backlog drained and scheduling latencies normalized. No node OOMs or throttles observed.

p m-amy: (typo) sorry, pm-amy: please prepare a short customer note: "We noted elevated streaming latency after a canary encoder change; traffic has been rolled back and service is stable. We're investigating and will share RCA." Keep message concise.

support-bot: Draft added to INC-2026-411. Notifications queued for affected accounts.

eng-leo: triage actions: 1) Confirm rollback propagated globally (done). 2) Capture model/config diff between v13 and v14 (runtime-maria). 3) Reproduce using traffic replay harness with long-stream profiles. 4) Add long-stream synthetic test to pre-rollout pipeline. 5) Schedule RCA within 72h.

runtime-maria: attached model diff hash: sha256:abcdeffedcba and uploaded sample request IDs and traces to incident artifacts. Added a small repro script in the artifacts bucket.

infra-akash: mitigation suggestion: for encoder/tok changes, enable KV pre-warm and reduce canary weight <2% for 10 minutes before ramp. Also add a threshold on multiplexer queue depth to auto-hold rollouts.

p m-amy: (pm-amy) agree, please add to rollout checklist and Redwood Optimize playbook.

auditor-bot: Audit: oncall-jon executed route update at 3959998025; rollback command recorded.

oncall-jon: starting 10-minute watch, then handing paging to eng-leo for daytime follow-up. If we see re-regression, repage.

eng-leo: acknowledged. I'll keep a 30m watch and then create postmortem tasks. Assigning RCA lead: runtime-maria + infra-akash.

support-bot: Incident marked mitigated; paging suspended. Customer comms scheduled; RCA due in 72 hours.

runtime-maria: one more note: traces show some chunk reorder events during the spike; I'll attach the exact sequence numbers to the artefact and include a repro case.

oncall-jon: handing off at 3959998061 to eng-leo. Good job team. :thumbsup: If any account escalates, poke support and we'll reopen the page.
